purpose: Resolve documentary property units, record-key meanings and data/upstream-use declarations from the original tmQM paper. Preserve the distinction between its original2020 release and the pinned2024 extension; definitions are not automatically current-file validation.
identity_basis: Exact DOI cited by pinned curator README and already verified through Crossref; public report phase2-primary-github-source-survey-v1/paper_metadata/projection.json.

requests.purpose: Exact DOI identity and legitimate public primary-article identifier; abstract/results withheld.

requests.requires: Exactly one DOI-matching open-access PMCID from preceding metadata. No guessed ID, publisher retry, mirror or access workaround.
requests.purpose: Primary methods/data dictionary/availability permissions only; no scientific numerical outcomes or performance extraction.

transport: Ordinary HTTPS GET,30s timeout,no redirects,no retries,no credentials. Preserve first failure and stop affected route. No follow-up dataset, supporting-file, curator-page or other source request.
exposure: Whole bounded metadata and articleXML containers are machine-read and may include numeric target tables, examples and published performance. Researcher output is controlled documentary projection only; no target-free, fresh-data or unexposed-source claim.
projection: Identity metadata first. If XML is legitimately available, first show section titles/table captions with numeric tokens masked and front permission metadata; no abstract, result prose, table cells, figures or supplementary content. Before relevant methods/units/key/rights prose is shown, identify exact sections or bounded documentary passages; exclude Results/performance discussions and target examples. Any dictionary table must first be checked by its headers and must not include numerical observations. Preserve incidental documentary numerical exposure honestly.
rights: Article reuse terms, public availability language, curator repository grant and upstream CSD rights are distinct. No absent grant is inferred from silence and no free-download statement is promoted to unrestricted redistribution.
forbidden: Numerical targets, model performance or outcome tables
Downloaded code/notebook execution, fits, thresholds, allocations or scientific admission
Denied curator-page retry or alternate access
Linked supporting-data/body files, third-party contact or paidcompute
publication: Compact own paraphrase, exact relevant field/unit/key/rights labels with primary locators, selected metadata, receipts and source hashes. Raw article bodies and unrelated full text remain ignored.
